text:
rachel: heads-up: release CI flagged a minor bump because regendiff shows a bunch of openapi example changes + one property reorder. publish was auto-held. anyone grabbing this?
ci-bot: regendiff artifact: https://ci.internal/redwood/regendiff/3040001234 — tests: 8 failed. :warning:
tom: i pulled the artifact. 90% of diffs are `example` or `examples` value normalizations (case changes) and one change where map iteration produced a different property order. should be patch.
pradeep: this is breaking the python sdk sampleapp import path due to parameter order change in generated client. failing import: `from redwood_sdk import FooClient` -> runtime TypeError in sampleapp init.
rachel: short term: can we teach the semver bot to ignore example-only diffs and treat ordering-only changes as patch? also revert the typegen change that caused nondeterministic property iteration.
tom: i'll open a tiny PR to stable-sort properties in the typegen and add a golden-file test for parity across runs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/typegen/pull/450 (WIP).
pradeep: i'll add an `examples` filter to changeloggen and a semver unit test that classifies `examples`/`deprecatedDescription` diffs as patch. PR: https://github.com/redwood/changeloggen/pull/112 (WIP).
ci-bot: release-bot: publish is currently blocked pending PRs. canary staging held.
rachel: if we can't land both fixes in 2 hours we should disable automatic bumping and rerun CI manually to avoid cascading SDK publishes. i'll coordinate with release team.
tom: noted, adding deterministic-jitter seed fix for the flaky auth/retry integration test we saw earlier as well so we don't conflate failures.
pradeep: once PRs land let's run regendiff locally and confirm semver stays at patch; i'll post results. :thumbsup:
